styleBibleInline: Soft botanical watercolor illustration, loose wet-on-wet washes with delicate fine ink linework and dry-brush soft edges; NOT a photograph, NOT thick gouache impasto, NOT a 3D render. Palette: cream #F4EFE4, pale sage #C7D4B8, sage green #8FA07E, deep leaf green #6E8268, warm petal blush #E7C8B0, honey warm light #EBD9B4 — low saturation, cream and green dominant. Light: soft diffuse morning light, no hard shadows, cool diffusion from upper-left. Atmosphere: airy, highly transparent, only the faintest morning haze for depth. Camera: standing eye-level view, horizon around 40% from the bottom of the frame, mid focal length, gentle aerial perspective, no wide-angle distortion.
